title: Antibody isotypes and Fc silencing
learnerTask: Compare unchanged target-binding regions with changed Fc interactions and understand why silencing selected interactions does not turn every antibody function off.
gap: The map and practice correctly separate binding and selected Fc interactions, but a matched-molecule structural comparison would clarify what changes and what stays the same. Reuse the antibody-structure reference rather than inventing an all-or-nothing Fc switch.
accuracyGuardrails: Class switching and affinity maturation are distinct processes.
Keep Fc receptor/complement interactions distinct from FcRn recycling.
No universal half-life or safety inference from Fc silencing.
